title: Let Grass Seed Before First Cutting Baling
reason: Discusses the process of managing first cutting of pastures and the benefits of letting them go to seed

tasks.task: Allow first cutting grass to go to seed before baling

subtasks.text: Pay attention to the stemmyness of the grass when it is ready for first cutting
Understand that this practice will help overseed the pasture for future growth
Look at the clover and alfalfa mixed in with the grass to notice their presence
Note that allowing the grass to go to seed will ensure good soil contact for the seeds
Observe the small grains of rice-like seeds on top of the clover to identify grass seed
Consider letting the pasture grow for a couple extra weeks before first cutting
